description: Stage-six controlled physical faults on sealed normal RLBench samples. Trigger predicates depend only on actions or simulator attachment state, never policy-internal StateId or task outcome.

provenance.time_stall_trigger_selection: Selected from the current no-fault StackWine normal trace before cross-method fault comparison: after tick 40, first requested translation >= 1 cm, where local states are not control-equivalent. The earlier smoke-only trigger at tick 6 was rejected as a weakly moving control-equivalent segment and is not an experiment result.
provenance.grasp_failure_semantics: The selected close occurrence remains physically ineffective for its entire contiguous closed-command interval. A later grasp is allowed only after the policy explicitly commands open and starts a new close occurrence. Earlier 0.4 s and 1.0 s delay-only smoke runs were rejected as actuator-delay tests and are not experiment results.
